title: Jack's art turns to grids, matching a world-grid book

tellings.quote: he was incorporating grids in all of his artwork and in very incredibly intriguing ways.

plain: Jim Weiner, a witness in a 1976 encounter story, says that afterward, in Boston, an artist named Jack Weiner began putting grids into all of his artwork in very intriguing ways. Jim says those grids matched ideas in a book called The Anti-Gravity and the World Grid, by a writer named David Hatcher Childress, about a network of lines said to cover the Earth, and he also mentions a man named Mike Asherman. To him, the match hints that the experience left something behind in Jack's mind.
